title: Transfer 2 - Relative Arrival Signal Audit
goal: Measure how strongly bundled traces amplify from the pre-arrival baseline into the arrival and coda windows, then report per-file energy ratios.
skillBenefitRationale: `obspy-data-api` is the only critical shipped skill because the task depends on reliable sample-rate, timing, and channel metadata when extracting and auditing phase-relative waveform windows.
